preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n is between 1 and 100,000.
The lower bound l and upper bound r are between 1 and 1,000,000,000, with l <= r.

preconditions.expression: all(l <= a_i <= r for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements of sequence a are within the range [l, r].
The length of sequence a is n.
The length of the compressed sequence p is n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: All elements of the compressed sequence p are within the range [1, n].
All elements of the compressed sequence p are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no suitable sequence b exists, or a sequence of n integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' => all(l <= b_i <= r for b_i in return_value)
postconditions.description: If a suitable sequence b exists, all its elements are within the range [l, r].
If a suitable sequence b exists, its length is n.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' => all(c_i == b_i - a_i for c_i, b_i, a_i in zip([b_i - a_i for b_i in return_value], return_value, a))
postconditions.description: If a suitable sequence b exists, the sequence c derived from b and a has the correct elements.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' => all(p_i == sum(1 for c_j in [b_j - a_j for b_j in return_value] if c_j <= c_i) for p_i, c_i in zip(p, [b_i - a_i for b_i in return_value]))
postconditions.description: If a suitable sequence b exists, the compressed sequence of c matches the given compressed sequence p.
